name.value: Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort, BW Premier Collection

description.value: The Prestige Radium Hot Springs Resort sits in the village of Radium Hot Springs, minutes from the world-famous Hot Springs Pools and nestled in the Columbia River valley between the Rocky Mountain and Purcell ranges. It is a full-service resort under the BWH Hotels umbrella, offering mountain views, kitchenette-equipped rooms, and pet-friendly accommodations. The location makes it a natural base for cyclists riding Kootenay National Park or the Columbia Valley route.
